subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 13, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 13, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

It's been a busy week for the AcreetionOS team, with several exciting developments and updates to share with you. First and foremost, we're thrilled to announce that Rust 1.100.0 has been released, bringing with it a range of notable changes and improvements. This update is now available in our repositories, so be sure to update your systems to take advantage of the latest features and security patches.

In other news, we've been working hard to resolve a conflict with geocode-glib, which was causing issues with installed systems. Our community members have been instrumental in helping us identify and fix the problem, and we're grateful for their contributions. We've also made some significant updates to our Calamares configuration, including adding support for Wayland and fixing a sequence entry that was causing init failures.

We're also excited to introduce Polo, a new Wayland MATE compositor that's now available in our repositories. This is a major milestone for AcreetionOS, and we're looking forward to seeing how it performs in real-world use cases. In addition, we've made some significant updates to our Firefox package, including restoring window position restore on Linux.

On the development front, our team has been hard at work on a range of projects, including the Acreetion-surf v2.0.0 release. This update brings a range of new features and improvements, including a more streamlined user interface and enhanced performance. We're also working on a new package called firefox-fix, which restores window position restore on Linux.

We're grateful for the contributions of our community members, who have been instrumental in helping us identify and fix issues with our software. We're committed to providing a stable and secure platform for our users, and we couldn't do it without your help.

As always, we're committed to transparency and openness in our development process. We believe that by working together, we can create a better, more secure, and more user-friendly Linux distribution. If you have any questions or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our issue tracker.

In other news, we've been working on some exciting new projects, including a Wayland session as default desktop environment. This is a major update that will provide a more seamless and integrated user experience. We're also exploring new ways to improve our software, including the use of AI and machine learning.

We're proud of the progress we've made so far, and we're excited to see what the future holds for AcreetionOS. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for our project. We couldn't do it without you!

As always, we're committed to providing a secure and stable platform for our users. We're constantly working to identify and fix issues, and we're grateful for the help of our community members in this effort.

Finally, we want to thank our community members for their continued support and enthusiasm for AcreetionOS. Your contributions, feedback, and suggestions are invaluable to us, and we're grateful for your help in making our project a success.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
